questions.q: Which firmware replaces BLHeli_S on 8-bit ESCs to get bidir DShot?
questions.explain: Bluejay is open-source firmware for the same EFM8 ESCs; it adds bidir DShot and EDT.

questions.q: What does the ESC send back with bidirectional DShot?
questions.explain: The ESC replies with eRPM; it's the input for the RPM filter and the ESC-driven notch.

questions.q: A 14-pole motor, the ESC reports 70,000 eRPM. Mechanical RPM?
What does EDT add to the DShot replies?
options: Encryption of the whole flight controller → ESC link
questions.explain: Extended DShot Telemetry sends the ESC status without a separate wire.

questions.q: What do you risk by flashing an ESC with the wrong target?
options: Only a reset of the startup melody
It not working or burned MOSFETs
Losing bidir DShot until a reboot
questions.explain: The target describes a specific board; a wrong one can kill the ESC.

questions.q: The motor twitches and stops on sharp throttle. What do you adjust first in the ESC?
questions.explain: It's a loss of sync; the fix is raising demag compensation and lowering the timing.

questions.q: Why doesn't passthrough work on the MAIN outputs in ArduPilot?
options: MAIN doesn't support DShot at all
They're IOMCU outputs, you need FMU/AUX
questions.explain: The IOMCU coprocessor outputs don't pass the signal through; use FMU/AUX.

options: It was open-sourced under the GPL
questions.explain: BLHeli_32 is no longer developed; for ARM ESCs with a target there's an open-source replacement, AM32.
